correctness.rationale: The graph is the induced disjoint-triple graph on the 28 non-Fano lines among the 35 triples of seven points. The source checker supplies an exact integer B with RB=56I for its reduced 27×27 Laplacian, calculates det(R)=2^18·7^5, and modular ranks 21 (mod2) and 22 (mod7). Thus all Smith factors divide 56; precisely six have a 2-factor, all with exponent three, and precisely five have a single 7-factor, giving invariant factors 8, 56 five times. Independent construction of the canonical graph and SymPy integer Smith normal form gives exactly 21 unit factors, 8, and five 56 factors, with determinant 4405854208. This is an exhaustive exact finite matrix calculation, not inferred solely from a spectrum or a script success flag.
